## Common answers

- Sessions needed: 6-10 for most areas, spaced 4-8 weeks apart
- Result: 80-90% permanent hair reduction; remaining regrowth is finer and lighter
- Pain: described as a warm snap; contact cooling and motion passes reduce discomfort
- Dark skin: safe, treated with lower fluence and longer pulse width; patch test required
- Hair colours that do NOT respond: white, grey, and true red hair (no melanin to target)
- Preparation: shave 12-24 hours before; no waxing, plucking or threading for two weeks prior
- Aftercare: no sauna, hot tub or intense exercise for 24 hours; SPF 30+ for two weeks
- Session length: underarms 10 min, Brazilian 15-25 min, full legs 40-50 min, full body 90 min
